name: Color Volume Optimization and Density Initialization
definition: An optimization pipeline to reconstruct a volume from images by first optimizing a color volume (storing rgb-emission and scalar absorption per voxel) to avoid local minima with non-monotonic transfer functions, then estimating a density volume from the color volume to serve as initialization for final density optimization.
summary: Color Volume Optimization and Density Initialization bypasses non-monotonic transfer function local minima by first optimizing a color volume, then analytically deriving a low-density initialization to ensure accurate gradient flow.
